title: In the Matter and Aliro Door Lock Application of the Nordic Semiconductor nRF Door Lock and Access Control Add-on…
description: A vulnerability in the Matter and Aliro Door Lock Application of the Nordic Semiconductor nRF Door Lock and Access Control Add-on versions 1.0.0 through 1.1.1 allows an attacker to bypass rollback protection. This occurs due to an off-by-one error in handling credential issuer deletion when CONFIG_DOOR_LOCK_STEP_UP_PHASE is enabled, causing the validity iteration state of an adjacent issuer to be cleared incorrectly. An attacker with an older but validly signed Access Document from the adjacent issuer can potentially gain unauthorized physical access. The issue is fixed in version 1.2.0.
